messages:
Priya Raman: quick pulse on the "inference-routing" GA readiness. I'm proposing a narrow launch: minimal SLA, clear doc surface, and conservative telemetry sampling. Need thumbs on commercial stance and operational handoffs.
Sam Torres: minimal SLA ok but define precisely: p99 server-side request completion for non-streaming; streaming will use p95 for chunk latency. Also clarify what constitutes "server-side" completion.
Evan Wu: Ops note 1: set full-trace sampling to 0.5% at launch; collect latency histograms at 5%. That keeps costs low and still gives signal for regressions.
Lena Park: Docs checklist I care about: Quickstart cURL + small SDK example, SLA wording paragraph, known limitations, and a 'cost estimation' quick table. I'll draft the SLA paragraph.
Sam Torres: add an example metrics query for the p99 definition. e.g.:
```
query: percentile_over_time(99, latency_ms{route="/v1/generate",status="200"}, "1h")
```
Priya Raman: Commercial ask from sales: they want a short, non-binding blurb for contracts. Proposed copy: "Partial latency commitment for Tier A hosted customers; credits and exceptions subject to finance approval." Keep it intentionally non-committal.
finance-bot: FYI: credits need legal sign-off; Finance prefers 'service credit framework TBD' instead of numeric credits at Day 1.
Evan Wu: Oncall routing: Tier A alerts -> infra rotation; Tier B noisy alerts -> product rotation with automated debounce. I'll put the escalation steps into the runbook.
Lena Park: Ownership: Docs first draft by Wed EOD (I'll own SLA copy), Quickstart and examples by Priya, Cost table Sam/Evan.
Priya Raman: decision proposal: ship GA beta with partial SLA (p99 non-streaming), launch telemetry sampling (0.5% full traces / 5% latency histograms), docs minimal set, commercial soft language. agree to proceed unless a hard blocker appears.
Sam Torres: No blocker from engineering. I'll add the metric query and streaming fallback note.
Evan Wu: I'll add the runbook snippet today and set sampling knobs in staging.
finance-bot: I'll coordinate legal language with Contracts.
ops-bot: Staging rollout of routing config completed at 1725000039. No regressions seen. :white_check_mark:
Priya Raman: OK moving forward. Owners check-in tomorrow 10am PT to validate drafts. If anyone raises hard blockers post that, we'll postpone shipping. :thumbsup:
